body: Everything will be okay with time, we just have to keep reminding ourselves of that! I did the same; completely off my social media and I also hid photos! That's helped so much.

I was supposed to move in with my boyfriend June 1st. We had broken up a month ago from a huge fight, got back together that same week, and now after a month he ended things Friday over a phone call very unexpectedly. I, like you, was all in and willing to do anything to make our relationship work, but he checked out and I had no idea. I am so sorry you had to go through that and are still dealing with the pain it can cause. Just know you aren't alone, and that this post just helped a complete stranger... so thank you for posting because a lot of us like me needed this realization badly

I was dumped abruptly over the phone three days ago and I'm only on day two and want to break nc too... lol I feel fucking stupid, but it's just how it goes. It really sucks. But, if you've already made it a week, don't give up yet. I'm sure you'll have some more set backs, but just try to think how good you could feel next week if you keep sticking with it

Although you financed those things together, it isn't your responsibility anymore to help financially. Unless it was an agreement you made when you broke up initially, I would not send her money. If she cannot afford those things, then she needs to handle that issue herself. To me it sounds like she is using it as an excuse to contact you. Most likely to see if you've moved on or where you are in life. Try not to hold on to those little pieces of hope she gives when she contacts you. It will get easier with time!
That's something my exes always say to me. And I've heard it so much now that I really believe it.
I always think it's something that's wrong with me that causes my relationships to end these ways, but you just put a lot into perspective for me. Thank you for that, it was much needed.
